$comment: TestCrack exam directory — single source of truth for every exam string rendered on the public site.
HARD RULE (TC-02 Q14, TC-03 §5.1): no component may hand-type an exam name. Every visible exam
string on the marketing site reads from this file. One template renders /exams and every
/exams/<slug> page, so adding an exam is a content change, not a development task.
legalDisplayName and trademarkOwner are PLACEHOLDERS pending the Indian IP lawyer opinion that
TC-03 §9 lists as open and owned by the founder. Ship the mechanism now; confirm the strings before
any exam-named marketing copy goes live.
status vocabulary — this is what keeps the exam grid honest:
live        shipped, question bank validated, sellable today
in_build    committed and in active development, dated
configured  registered in ExamConfig, no validated question bank yet
roadmap     sales-qualified only; built on signed demand, not speculatively
